name: Uro-Oncology: Bladder, Kidney and Testis Cancers

reference.source: Campbell-Walsh-Wein Urology 12th Edition (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
reference.pathophysiology: Smoked urothelia papillary muscle invading BCG responsive while clear cells VHL vascularising tyrosine inhibited; markered germ cells chemosensitive banking sperm, and adrenal lumps hormonally hypersecreting blocked alpha.
additionalDifferentials: NMIBC versus MIBC by muscle and BCG
Partial versus radical by T and RENAL
Seminoma versus non-seminoma by markers and RPLND
